headline: Tawhid Hridoy breaks Tamim Iqbal's record with triple century
summary: The batsman scored over 350 runs in a single first-class innings, becoming the first Bangladeshi to achieve this feat on foreign soil.
details: Tawhid Hridoy has set a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in first-class cricket. He surpassed Tamim Iqbal's previous record of 334 runs, which was set in 2019 during the Bangladesh Cricket League (BCL) in Mirpur.
Hridoy achieved this milestone during a match against South Africa 'A' in Potchefstroom, where he scored a triple century.
With this innings, he becomes the first Bangladeshi batsman to score a triple century on foreign soil.
The batsman's performance was highlighted by a massive innings of over 350 runs, further cementing his place as a record-breaker in the country's cricket history.
caption:
A new record has been set! Tawhid Hridoy has surpassed Tamim Iqbal's long-standing first-class score.

Tawhid Hridoy has set a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in first-class cricket. He surpassed Tamim Iqbal's previous record of 334 runs, which was set in 2019 during the Bangladesh Cricket League (BCL) in Mirpur.

Hridoy achieved this milestone during a match against South Africa 'A' in Potchefstroom, where he scored a triple century.

With this innings, he becomes the first Bangladeshi batsman to score a triple century on foreign soil.

The batsman's performance was highlighted by a massive innings of over 350 runs, further cementing his place as a record-breaker in the country's cricket history.

headline: ACC starts investigation against Asif Mahmud and 3 others
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has launched a probe into corruption allegations involving the former advisor.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has initiated an investigation into corruption allegations against former advisor Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan and three others.
The commission decided to probe the matter following allegations of financial irregularities and corruption.
The ACC is currently gathering information and evidence to determine the further course of action in the case.
This move comes as part of the commission's efforts to investigate corruption claims involving high-profile individuals.
